message: 流星一揆

name: Ria
message: 「It's so quiet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. It feels strange seeing the grounds completely empty at this hour.」
If I remember right, club activities get suspended around this time of year.
What was the reason again... I can't remember, oh well.

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe...」

name: Synn
message: 「It's really interesting, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「The school shows so many different sides of itself just from a slight change in time or circumstances.」

name: Synn
message: 「Being able to become a member of the Student Council and the Crusaders makes me feel that way even more.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, seeing all the different faces of the academy is really important, after all.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Though, there was a side to it that you and the others never got to see, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Us? Then, back when you were a first-year, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... When I was a freshman, the Student Council was in a Warring States era of rival warlords, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「I guess their war expenses piled up way too high. And so...」

name: Ria
message: 「W-W-What a shock?! Ta-da!! For the bread-eating race at the sports festival, they hung up plain sliced sandwich bread!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-Thick six-slice loaves, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope, ultra-thin eighteen-slice bread for sandwiches!」

name: Paqy
message: 「T-That's cruel. Way too cruel, that's grounds for a riot!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! Right in the middle of the sports festival, an actual rebellion broke out!」

name: Ria
message: 「Deciding they couldn't let things go on like this, all the regular students united and rose up.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「And thus, the Student Council repented of its ways. The end!」

name: Synn
message: 「To think an incident like that happened at Ryuusei Academy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, Helena basically leaves things up to the students' own initiative, seems like.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, sure, that paper-thin bread was probably the trigger, but that couldn't have been all there was to it, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if regular students threw a reckless uproar, they wouldn't have enough power to reform the Student Council's whole organization.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Which means there was some hero or heroine with a rock-solid goal who stood at the front and led everyone, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, someone with that kind of drive... The only person who comes to mind is...」

name: Ria
message: 「Achoo!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gahhh... Man, I really wish I could've seen the gallant figure of the heroine who sparked a school revolution!」

name: Ria
message: 「I-It wasn't me!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Paqy didn't even mention your name, Ria-senpai?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... I'm falling for Ria-chan all over again.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph! Tricking me into confessing like that--bad Paa-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing... I'm no match for you, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Uuuh. I-It really wasn't me, okay? It was an upperclassman who already graduated. You don't believe me, do you, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I said I believe you!」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, then why are you running away, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Since we have the whole place to ourselves, I just feel like breaking into a run.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, in that case, I feel like catching you, Synn-kun\s07」
Senpai and I enjoyed playing tag for a little while.
Honestly, who really was the great student that reformed the Student Council?
...Let's leave a legend as a legend. Better not pry too much into it, yeah.
